function.name: PUT_SCREEN
function.abstract: It draws a graph in the background of screen

description.p: This function draws a graph in the background of screen, in the center of the screen. Normally, it is used with a graph that has the size of the screen. For that it is good to have a graphs of background representing screens or levels, and to draw them using this function. For better techniques, it can be used functions like or .
